Confirms the two new facets actually fired (or stayed off) at runtime, not merely per config inspection.
preconditions.control: runtime engagement diagnostics on every cell of all arms

preconditions.description: action_object_decoder_raw_output_stats.std_by_action_dim is a non-empty finite vector on every cell -- the DV can be read. A washed-out (near-zero) per-mode gap is a valid result; an EMPTY/NaN readout is a measurement failure.
preconditions.control: decoder raw-output std vector length + finiteness, every cell

criteria.name: C_at_least_one_fix_arm_clears_floor_with_off_washed_out
criteria.note: THE localisation test: >=1 fix arm clears FLOOR_PRODUCTION while the OFF control stays washed out. If no fix arm clears, the fix is insufficient at iters=3. If OFF also clears, the control premise (wash-out at iters=3) failed and the reading is ambiguous.

interpretation.combination_rule: outcome = FAIL/non_contributory if the raw_std readout is unpopulated on any cell, or the manipulation check fails (a facet did not engage as configured) -- neither is informative about the fix. Else, on a valid measurement: PASS iff >=1 fix arm's across-seed mean broad-minus-tight raw_std gap clears FLOOR_PRODUCTION AND the OFF control does not (the wash-out localisation). FAIL/label=fix_insufficient if no fix arm clears; FAIL/label=control_leak if OFF also clears (premise violated). evidence_direction is always non_contributory (diagnostic): the finding is WHICH fix locus holds, not a claim-supporting or claim-weakening reading.
